summary: Explains why the authentication option is needed for Mobile IPv6 signalling between a mobile node and its home agent, in addition to IPsec protection. It supports the case for the option that secures Binding Update and Binding Acknowledgement messages. This is an informational document.

eli5.summary: This memo explains why a special extra proof-of-identity stamp is worth adding on top of the lock already used in a traveling device's messages.

questions: why mobile ipv6 needs the authentication option
